name: vibe-kanban
description: Vibe Kanban is an AI-first software development project management tool. It uses AI agents to help manage and track software development tasks. This container includes GitHub CLI, Docker CLI, and OpenAI Codex for a complete development environment. Always available: Codex, SVGO, imagemagick, libvips, librsvg, ripgrep, jq, tree, bat, fd, tmux, nano, python3, pip, pipx. For detailed setup instructions, see: https://vibekanban.com/docs

paths.name: Path: Project Data
paths.description: Persistent storage for Vibe Kanban data (config, database).

paths.name: Path: Cache
paths.description: Cache directory for Vibe Kanban and agent tools.

paths.name: Path: Workspace
paths.description: Main workspace directory for your projects.

ports.name: Port: Web UI
ports.description: HTTP port for the Vibe Kanban web interface.

variables.name: Variable: PORT
variables.description: Port for Vibe Kanban to listen on (should match Container Port above).

variables.name: Variable: HOST
variables.description: Host address to bind to (0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

variables.name: --- Git Configuration ---
variables.description: Git author information used for commits. Docs: https://vibekanban.com/docs

variables.name: --- API Keys (Advanced) ---
variables.description: Optional API keys. For security, use secrets or environment files in production. Docs: https://vibekanban.com/docs/self-hosting/environment-variables

variables.name: Variable: GH_TOKEN
variables.description: GitHub personal access token (alternative to GitHub CLI auth).

variables.name: Variable: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.description: OpenAI API key for Codex and AI features.

variables.name: --- Runtime Tools ---
variables.description: Install additional tools at container startup. Always available: Codex, SVGO, imagemagick, libvips, librsvg, ripgrep, jq, tree, bat, fd, tmux, nano, python3, pip, pipx

variables.name: Variable: RUNTIME_AGENTS
variables.value: claude gemini copilot amp cursor opencode droid clauderouter qwen
variables.description: Coding agents to install (space-separated). Options: claude, gemini, copilot, amp, cursor, opencode, droid, clauderouter, qwen

variables.name: Variable: RUNTIME_PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS
variables.description: Playwright browsers to install (space-separated). Options: chromium, firefox, webkit

variables.name: Variable: RUNTIME_TESTING_TOOLS
variables.description: Testing tools to install (space-separated). Options: vitest, jest, msw

variables.name: Variable: RUNTIME_PYTHON_TOOLS
variables.description: Python tools to install via pipx (space-separated). Options: httpie, black, ruff, mypy, pytest, isort, autoflake, pip-audit, safety

variables.name: Variable: LOCAL_UID
variables.description: UID to run the container process as (default: 99 for nobody user).

variables.name: Variable: LOCAL_GID
variables.description: GID to run the container process as (default: 100 for users group).
